node.statement: With a=h-J, one has h=J+a; exact unitality and bilinearity yield h bold-dot h-J=2a+a bold-dot a. Hence, by the reverse triangle inequality and the product-norm axiom, 2||a||<=||h bold-dot h-J||+||a bold-dot a||<=80*e+(1+e)||a||^2. Nodes 1.1 and 1.4.1 give e<=1/64 and ||a||<1/64, so 2-(1+e)||a||>2-65/4096>63/32. Rearranging the preceding inequality gives ||a||<=(80*32/63)e=(2560/63)e<41e. Since ||h-J||=||a||, this proves the asserted polar-factor bound.
